tools.name: scan_wallet
tools.description: Checks a Solana wallet for risks and gives a 0-100 safety score: open token approvals, phishing airdrops, Token-2022 permanent delegates and transfer restrictions, stake and nonce accounts controlled by someone else, and whether the wallet account itself has been taken over. Also totals the SOL lock

tools.name: list_empty_token_accounts
tools.description: Lists a Solana wallet's empty token accounts (left behind by sold or sent tokens), the SOL rent locked in each, and which ones SealGuard suggests closing. Accounts for tokens the owner will likely receive again, or used in the last 30 days, are marked to keep, with the reason. Also lists pump.fun an

tools.name: list_token_approvals
tools.description: Lists every token approval (delegate) on a Solana wallet: which address can still move which token, and how much. Also lists Token-2022 permanent delegates, which holders can't revoke. Read-only; returns a link where the owner can revoke approvals for free.
